report.summary: Quieter console (MSPI/ADC), MQTT username + persisted log level on /settings, and working `log` tag listing plus `help`; builds clean.

report.templateApplied: korvo-heating-panel (composed product, re-used — no re-apply this round)

components.name: app_logic
components.notes: New log_level.cpp owns the one persisted console verbosity (NVS ns zc_log, key level): default level for every tag, with MSPI and ADC held at WARN below it. Applied at boot from app_main BEFORE esp_board_manager_init(), so the board bring-up noise is gone from the first line. Console `log` now: no args = table of every product/framework/driver tag with its live level (esp_log_level_get) + the stored verbosity; `log <tag>` reads one; `log <tag> LEVEL` is a this-boot override; `log * LEVEL` stores the panel-wide choice (what /settings shows). Product registers its own `help` (app_console_print_commands) because the REPL destroys the command registry. /settings: added broker username field (pre-filled from app_mqtt_user(), empty keeps stored) and a log-level <select> (ERROR/WARN/INFO/DEBUG/VERBOSE); apply_form now restarts the broker only when uri/user/password actually changed, and applies+stores the level via heating_log_level_set().

components.name: app_console
components.notes: Added app_console_print_commands() (declared in app_console.h) — the command list for the product's `help`. It exists because every esp_console_new_repl_*() de-inits and re-creates the command registry, so commands registered before the REPL starts (the app_console built-ins included) no longer exist when a user types; the REPL therefore has no `help` at all. The list mirrors register_builtin_cmds() plus the product's commands and must be kept in step. No other framework behaviour changed.

consoleCommands: log (list tags / read one / set one / log * LEVEL stores the panel-wide verbosity)
help (command list — registered by the product over app_console_print_commands)
openQuestions: Power-cycle suppression of MSPI/ADC noise before app_main is impossible: the app_console built-ins (reboot/mem/…) are wiped by esp_console_new_repl_*(), so esp_console_run('mem') would report 'Unrecognized command' — that pre-existing bug is untouched and worth its own fix.
notes: The ADC tag covers the board's ADC-button group; it is held at WARN together with MSPI, so button clicks no longer print, while the button events themselves still log from the `control` tag.
The log level is applied only from NVS at boot; the build's VERBOSE default remains in sdkconfig.defaults as the fallback when nothing was ever chosen.

Broker restart on Save was tightened: app_mqtt_set_broker() now only runs when uri, username or password actually differ from the stored values, so saving other fields no longer drops the MQTT session.
